thin: Mesa's official pages name only the City's own line and shelter plus a few phone numbers, and 211's shelter results near Mesa are mostly Phoenix transitional programmes; the only list naming Mesa day services (Streets of Joy, Mesa House, Salvation Army) is a coffee shop's community page. Day centres, meal-and-shower sites and East Valley shelters beyond the Men's Center and I-HELP are where Scout's own search still has to work. Matches corrected by hand: Helaman House (tool picked Autumn House), Tempe HOPE (picked an unrelated outreach), Set Free (none), 211 (re-matched), Safe Place (Scout has two Safe Place entries, Lifeology AZ and Child Crisis Arizona; operator not checked).
